caseName: Texaco Refining & Marketing Inc. v. Estate of Van Tran
caseNameFull: Texaco Refining & Marketing Inc. v. Estate of Dau Van Tran

opinions.text:
Ct. App. Tex., 9th Dist. Motion of Maritime Law Association of the United States for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, *1021judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in

light of Sisson v. Ruby, ante, p. 358.

Justice Stevens dissents.
